stories.title: Amazon plans electric charge points to decarbonise Deeside deliveries
stories.summary: An Amazon warehouse in Deeside is seeking to install its own electricity substation as it looks to increase the electrification of its delivery van fleet. stories.title: Buckley Common Pond fish stable so far, community group says, as drought grips Wales
stories.summary: A community group says the fish in Buckley Common Pond are stable for now, but has warned conditions could worsen if the hot, dry weather continues. stories.title: Drought status declared across Wales as hot weather and lack of rain takes its toll
stories.summary: Drought status has been declared across Wales following a sustained period of high temperatures and a lack of rainfall. Natural Resources Wales (NRW) said today that conditions across Wales’ natural environment had continued to deteriorate, with some groundwater levels lower than expected for this time of year. stories.title: UEFA and its members, including Wales, agree not to enter FIFA tournaments while World Cup sell-off plan remains
stories.summary: Wales is one of 55 European football associations that have agreed not to take part in FIFA competitions while plans to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors remain on the table. stories.title: Water supplies hit in Queensferry, Shotton and Sandycroft after burst main
stories.summary: Homes in Queensferry, Shotton and Sandycroft have low pressure or no water after a burst water main, with supplies not expected back to normal until this evening.
